lines.zh: 我笑着走过草地，笑没停过。
lines.en: I cross the grass smiling, and the smile never stops.
A sway to each step, like a stroll.

lines.zh: 我绕过你的房子，慢慢地走。
lines.en: I walk around your house, slowly.
The grass doesn't bend under me.
I head for your window.
I walk and watch you the whole way.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，可我一直在靠近。
lines.en: I'm not fast, and I keep getting closer.
My face never changes.
I stop at your door and move on.

lines.zh: 我在树后面走，你只能看见一半。
lines.en: I walk behind the trees; you see only half of me.
I come along the field ridge.

lines.zh: 每一步都一样长，一样慢。
lines.en: Every step the same length, the same slowness.

lines.zh: 我站着笑，牙齿露在外面。
lines.en: I stand and smile, teeth showing.

lines.zh: 我不动，你不会知道我在等。
lines.en: I don't move; you won't know I'm waiting.
Night is deep, and I'm wide awake.
My smile runs ear to ear.
I listen to the sounds inside your house.
I dip my head slightly.

lines.zh: 风把我的衣角吹起来，我不理。
lines.en: The wind lifts my hem; I ignore it.
No moon tonight — good.
When I smile, there's no sound.

lines.zh: 我站在这儿，等天亮前的两分钟。
lines.en: I stand here for the two minutes before dawn.

lines.zh: 你看见我了，我的笑更大了。
lines.en: You've seen me, and my smile widens.
I face you and don't blink.

lines.zh: 你看我多久了？我数着的。
lines.en: How long have you looked? I've been counting.
This smile isn't friendly.

lines.zh: 你把视线移开，我也不走。
lines.en: Look away and I still won't leave.

lines.zh: 我的头歪了一点，笑还在。
lines.en: My head tilts a little; the smile stays.
Three seconds of looking, and I'm on my way.
I say nothing; only the face.
The longer you look, the happier I get.

lines.zh: 我往前挪了一点，你没退。
lines.en: I edge forward and you don't step back.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛告诉我你要跑了。
lines.en: Your eyes tell me you're about to run.
Don't be afraid; I'm only smiling.
Three seconds are up; my turn.
My smile splits.
My head lolls, and the smile stays.
That blow sends me far back.
Blood lands on my face.

lines.zh: 我没有叫，只是笑得更大。
lines.en: I don't cry out; I smile wider.
I brace against a tree.
My body feels loose.

lines.zh: 血滴在笑脸上，我舔了舔。
lines.en: Blood drips on my smile; I lick it.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把笑收回来一点。
lines.en: I pull the smile in a little.
I retreat, still watching you.
I don't eat; I only smile.

lines.zh: 你把它放在地上，往后退。
lines.en: You set it down and back away.
I walk right past it.

lines.zh: 我低头看了一眼，笑没变。
lines.en: I glance down; the smile doesn't change.
You'd trade that for one quiet night?
I nudge it aside with a toe.
It rolls twice on the ground.

lines.zh: 你一直举着，我就一直笑。
lines.en: Keep holding it and I'll keep smiling.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，我的笑歪了一下。
lines.en: You hit me and the smile slips.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，又站回原位。
lines.en: I step back and return to the same spot.
I brace on the wall; the smile holds.

lines.zh: 你从我身上穿过去一样。
lines.en: It feels like you passed through me.

lines.zh: 我们相撞，没有一点声音。
lines.en: We collide without a sound.

lines.zh: 我低头看被你碰到的地方。
lines.en: I look at the place you touched.
A short laugh escapes me.
I slide past your shoulder.
I straighten up and smile at you again.
Both of us are smiling.
Her smile sits at the same angle as mine.

lines.zh: 我们面对面站着，不说话。
lines.en: We stand face to face without speaking.
Her teeth are whiter than mine.
We tilt our heads at the same moment.
The night covers us both.

lines.zh: 她往前一步，我把脸低下去。
lines.en: She steps forward and I lower my face.
Neither smile makes a sound.

lines.zh: 她走开时还回头看了一眼。
lines.en: She looks back once as she leaves.
We split this night in half.
I pick it up without breaking the smile.
I tuck it inside my clothes.
I squeeze it and it gives.
I carry it toward you.
I hold it up before your eyes.
It's dirty; I don't care.
I bite it, then spit.
I wedge it into a crack in the wall.
I hold it a while, then drop it.
There's no use in keeping it.
You've come within eight — far too close.
My smile opens into a mouth.
I stop standing still.
Tonight I don't plan on leaving.

lines.zh: 你的屋门有一块松动的木板。
lines.en: One board in your door is loose.
I've noted every window.
When I move, the air goes cold.
Run, and I'll follow.
I charge forward smiling.

lines.zh: 前面那道坎我一步就过。
lines.en: That low wall ahead is one step for me.
Lamp out, and the distance is gone.
Don't shut the door; it won't help.
All that's left is for you to turn.
I follow step by step, never running.
You look away and I advance again.

lines.zh: 我把挡路的栅栏掰开了。
lines.en: I snap the fence in my way.

lines.zh: 木板被我推开，掉在地上。
lines.en: I shove the boards aside and they fall.

lines.zh: 我一直笑，笑得脸都酸了。
lines.en: I keep smiling until my face aches.

lines.zh: 你家门口那盏灯我记住了。
lines.en: I've marked the lamp by your door.
You're inside, bracing the door.
I stand outside with great patience.
I know you left by the back window.
I go around to the back window.

lines.zh: 一路上我没有碰到一根草。
lines.en: I haven't touched a single blade of grass.
I walk through your garden smiling.

lines.zh: 你越跑越远，我越走越快。
lines.en: The farther you run, the faster I walk.
I don't pant; I don't tire.
You've snapped a branch.
Now I know where you are.

lines.zh: 我把路上的门都关上了。
lines.en: I've closed every door on your way.

lines.zh: 你前面只剩院子的栅栏。
lines.en: Only the yard fence is left ahead of you.
I still have time before dawn.
My smile comes right up to your face.

lines.zh: 这一下把你推得撞上墙。
lines.en: The shove puts you into the wall.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的手腕，很用力。
lines.en: I grip your wrist hard.

lines.zh: 我用整只手掌压你的胸口。
lines.en: I press my whole palm to your chest.
You kick me and I tilt my head, smiling.
I pin you against the door.
My teeth find your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你挣开一只手，我立刻又抓住。
lines.en: You free one hand; I take it again.
I drag you toward the yard's edge.
I laugh out loud, high and thin.

lines.zh: 你打我，我退半步，笑更大。
lines.en: You hit me; I step back and smile wider.

lines.zh: 我用手臂锁住你的脖子。
lines.en: I lock an arm around your neck.
You start clawing at my face.
My smile is knocked crooked.
I loosen slightly and you struggle again.
I look down at you, still smiling.
One last push and you're on the ground.

lines.zh: 我蹲下来，脸对着你的脸。
lines.en: I crouch, face to face with you.

lines.zh: 天黑下来，我先出现在田边。
lines.en: Night falls and I appear at the field's edge.

lines.zh: 我脸上那个笑，从出现就有。
lines.en: The smile is there the moment I appear.

lines.zh: 周围的虫忽然都不叫了。
lines.en: The insects suddenly all stop.

lines.zh: 我站在暗处，慢慢转向你。
lines.en: I stand in the dark and slowly turn to you.
My shadow doesn't follow me.
There's a tang of rust in the air.

lines.zh: 我一步一步走到你家门前。
lines.en: I walk step by step to your door.
I don't knock; I only stand.
My smile is very white in the dark.
I'll be here for two minutes.
Your lamp is still on; I'll wait.
I came from the woods.
Then I start walking toward the light.

lines.zh: 这一夜，整片地都归我了。
lines.en: Tonight the whole of this place is mine.
Fire warps my smile.
I land in the grass, smile still showing.
Water pours into the smiling mouth.
Gunpowder scattered my smile.
An arrow passes through my shoulder.

lines.zh: 那道光让我的笑僵住了。
lines.en: That light freezes the smile on me.
I'm too starved to hold the smile.

lines.zh: 雷光一闪，我的脸照得发白。
lines.en: The flash turns my face white.
I fall, and the smile stays on.
